blog_posts.title: How to Rank #1 in Google Maps Local Pack in 2026
blog_posts.author: Pixelwyre SEO Team
blog_posts.excerpt: Discover the 5 proven local SEO strategies to dominate GMB Map Pack rankings, generate 450% more calls, and automate customer reviews.
blog_posts.content:
Ranking #1 in the Google Maps Local Pack is the single most profitable digital channel for local businesses in Pakistan and worldwide. Over 74% of high-intent local customer searches result in immediate phone calls or direct clinic/store visits.

1. Claim & Verify 100% Complete GMB Profile
